.. py:data:: DONE_FILE

.. py:function:: _write_done_marker(output_dir: pathlib.Path, *, job_id: str, exit_code: int, output_files: list[str], error=None) -> None

   Write a ``.done`` JSON marker in *output_dir* recording job id, exit code, produced output
   files, finish timestamp, and any error — signals the GUI that the job finished.


.. py:function:: main(job_path: pathlib.Path) -> None

   Run a staged GUI tool inside Singularity (no Napari).
